title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the metadata list reads, the audit read and the UI-view read through the protocol host (#25467 E2 cut 1a)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UmbUGPtw5rdRcd3UpYXs5N)_

Part of #25467

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把 `protocol.ts` 里“元数据读取”一节的前半（列表读取 `getMetaItems` 及其两种变体、共享的 `readFlattenedMetaItems`，外加 `auditMetaItem`、`getUiView`）的方法体，经 E1 的宿主机制原样搬进两个新模块；6 个方法仍留在类上（签名与文档不变），方法体变成一行转发。
- **为什么改**：#25467 裁决 E 的 E2 第 1 节（按席位裁定拆成 1a/1b，每个 PR 1,000–3,000 行），在声明的 `protocol.ts` 冻结日落地；1b（单项读取、分层读取）随后另开。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只做搬移：工具逐个证明 6 个方法体与原方法体在“`this.` 读作 `host.`”之外 AST 与文本全同；对外 `index.d.ts`（ESM 与 CJS）与 main 构建出的逐字节相同，`getMetaTypes()` 的推断类型块也逐字节相同。回滚即整体 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` 文件头；`protocol.ts` 里 6 个方法的转发体与类 `static {}` 块新增的宿主条目；`protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` 的改动。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd packages/metadata-protocol && node scripts/host-split.mjs check origin/main readFlattenedMetaItems protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`，预期 `"ok":true,"textIdentical":true`。
- **需要你做的**：无（约 2,500 行，低于 3,000 行线，席位自审）。

## What changes

Step **E2, section 1 "metadata reads", part 1a** of ruling E (6537939895), on the `protocol.ts` freeze day seat 5 declared (#28677). Seat 5 split section 1 into 1a and 1b to keep each PR within ruling E's band of 1,000 to 3,000 lines. This is a pure application of the E1 host pattern: no logic changes, and no new rewrite kind.

| member | moved to | rewrite sites (all `this.x` to `host.x`) |
|---|---|---:|
| `getMetaItems` | `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` | 1 |
| `getMetaItemsForExecution` | `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` | 1 |
| `getMetaItemsPerPackage` | `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` | 1 |
| `readFlattenedMetaItems` (809 lines) | `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` | 44 |
| `auditMetaItem` | `protocol-meta-audit-ui-view.ts` | 3 |
| `getUiView` | `protocol-meta-audit-ui-view.ts` | 1 |

Each method keeps its docblock, modifiers and signature on the class; its body becomes `return fn(protocolHost(this), …)`. `ProtocolHost` and the class's static block gain 26 entries (the members those bodies read; `engine`, `environmentId` and `getServicesRegistry` are read-only getters, the rest are call-time closures). `node scripts/host-split.mjs check origin/main MEMBER MODULE` reads `ok: true, textIdentical: true` for all six. Negative control, with `layer === 'effective'` changed to `!==` in `readFlattenedMetaItems`'s moved body, then restored:

```
PROBLEM protocol-meta-list-reads.ts:85: ExclamationEqualsEqualsToken where the base has EqualsEqualsEqualsToken (`===`)
PROBLEM protocol-meta-list-reads.ts: readFlattenedMetaItems's body text differs from the base body rewritten and re-indented, first at body line 3
```

`protocol.ts` drops seven import names only the moved bodies used (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`, `decorateMetadataItems`, `soleShippingPackage`, `isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage`, `viewIdentityPatch`, `perPackageLayerEnvelope`, `storedEntryRow`); each module imports what its bodies read from where `protocol.ts` imports it. No import comment was dropped: the one attached comment (`[#7774]`) also covers `itemDiscriminator`, which stays.

**The tool (`scripts/host-split.mjs`).** Measuring this section showed the survey misread two stub shapes, so its E1 note of "9 local named hosts" was wrong. `stubKindOf` now recognises:

- the per-member series' generic spelling, a parenthesised `fn` with an explicit type argument, then `.call(host, …)`;
- a plain `return fn(…)` passing exactly its own parameters, which is a body that read no member and moved earlier.

`move` now refuses a member that is already a stub. Before this, it would have "moved" `throwMetadataServiceUnavailable` and `namesWithOwnStoredRow`, which are already plain stubs. The survey now reads 174 stubs and 4 refusals. Two of the refusals are mixed stubs (`packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`, `namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal`), and the other two are `reconcileViewExpansions` (a private static field) and `publishPackageDrafts` (a bare `this`); none of the four is in section 1. Three new tests cover this, and `host-split.test.mjs` reads 38 tests. Ablation, deleting the instantiation-expression unwrap, then restored: 2 failed (`expected undefined to be 'call'`; `refuses to move stubbedGeneric again`).

## Forced test edits

Two by-path pins now read through the split. What each asserts is unchanged.

`src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`:

- The `readFlattenedMetaItems` site row carries `file: 'protocol-meta-list-reads.ts'`, where its body now stands.
- The member scanner names the class's `static {}` block, and a row records the host factory's `lookupArtifactItem` closure there. It has disposition `no`, because it forwards the moved bodies' calls unchanged. This is the same reasoning as cut 15's `shippedArtifactsOf` `...a` row.
- "Both read doors take their envelope from one rule" reads the list read's `const itemPackageId = envelopePackageId(packageId, it);` in `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`. It also requires that module to import `envelopePackageId` from `protocol-package-bindings.ts` and to define no copy.

Ablation, with that line changed to `const itemPackageId = packageId;` in the module, then restored: `Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, `expected '// Copyright …' to contain 'const itemPackageId = envelopePackage…'`.

`src/protocol.hydrate-overlay-canonical-type.test.ts` (#9111's closed caller set of `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`): the full suite found it red after the move (`expected [ …(2) ] to have a length of 3 but got 2`), because one of the three calls now stands in `readFlattenedMetaItems`'s moved body as `host.hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry(`. The pin now counts `this.` calls in protocol.ts plus `host.` calls in every `protocol-*.ts` module, still exactly 3, and requires that at least one is read in a module. Ablation, planting a fourth `host.hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry(` call in `protocol-meta-audit-ui-view.ts`, then restored: `Tests 1 failed | 10 passed (11)`, `expected [ …(4) ] to have a length of 3 but got 4`. A bare reference that is not a call (`void host.hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`) does not count: 11 passed.

The read-verb pin (`protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`) and the read-seam census needed no edit: E1's resolution follows the new stubs. Read-verb ablation, dropping the fold from `getMetaItemsForExecution`'s moved body, then restored: `Tests 1 failed | 17 passed (18)`, `expected [ 'getMetaItemsForExecution' ] to deeply equal []`. The census reads 100 seams, the same as main 399df5bba8 (read in a scratch worktree of main).

## The published `.d.ts`

Built from main 399df5bba8 (this branch's merge of main) and from this head. `index.d.ts` is byte-identical: raw sha256 `450c9334…5d744e` on both sides, ESM equal to CJS, normaliser 2 `8d160c2b…78065` on both. The raw diff of `getMetaTypes()`'s emitted block (793 lines, its return type still inferred per the seat's E1 ruling) is empty.

The declaration-emit comment leak into that inferred type struck once after the cut: the `[#23316]` docblock printed inside `key?`. It was cleared the way E0 and E1 cleared it, by the length of the new import comment above the leaking offset. A probe of +1 to +8 characters read raw-equal at +3 to +6; the comment carries +5 (the word "also").

## Serial

Re-read just before opening against main 390bd2aedc (6 commits past this branch's merge of main, none in `packages/metadata-protocol`; `git merge-tree` with main is clean). Open PRs whose own diff touches `protocol.ts` or a `protocol-*.ts` module:

- #29456 (`protocol.ts` and `protocol-credential-carry-forward.ts`): its hunks sit at main lines 355 (the import list), 3739 to 3742 (`carryForwardRedactedCredentials`) and 17167 onward (`saveMetaItem`), all outside the moved section (main lines about 3851 to 7057). `git merge-tree` with this head is clean.
- #29437 (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` only): `git merge-tree` with this head is clean.

Seat 3's #29390 work (branch `claude/project-thread-gvqm55`, head d776e25828, no PR yet): its hunks sit at main lines 22104 and 22457 (the restore limb), outside the moved section. `git merge-tree` with this head is clean.

## Gates

On ec53149fff: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 62 commands, and each records `exit 0`. `--ran` reports 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The package's typecheck and test, through os-verify-lock, read Test Files 307 passed, 4 skipped; Tests 22232 passed, 26 skipped. The 11 direct dependents' typecheck exits 0. Lint (`eslint packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config`) exits 0. CI is not read.
